subject.title: [Feature]: Show additional information in `openclaw devices list`

question: Should this issue remain the broad tracking item for paired-device metadata/detail UX after the rename slice, or should it be narrowed to a specific `openclaw devices list` table/detail-mode change?
rationale: Current main stores much of the metadata, but the requested UX spans compact CLI output, possible `--full` detail output, first-run/default-device explanation, and editable names or notes that overlap a separate open rename PR.

options.title: Keep Broad Metadata UX
options.body: Keep this issue open as the broad tracker and define sanitized client/platform/activity/detail output after the rename slice is resolved.

options.title: Narrow To CLI Columns
options.body: Limit this issue to client/platform/activity columns or detail mode in `openclaw devices list`, leaving labels and notes to the naming issue and linked PR.

options.title: Treat Rename As Enough
options.body: Close or narrow this issue once the rename PR lands, explicitly deferring broader metadata and default-device explanation.

recommendation.title: Keep Broad Metadata UX
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the broad tracker and define sanitized client/platform/activity/detail output after the rename slice is resolved.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest history across device auth, pairing storage, the devices CLI, and prior review/product-boundary context for this issue.
